unitKo: 11과 운동을 좀 해 보는 게 어때요?
source: Seoul National University Korean 2B, Unit 11, tracks 12-19

lines.ko: 감기 아직 안 나았어요?
네, 기침이 계속 나요.
이 약을 하루에 몇 번 먹어야 돼요?
하루에 세 번씩, 여덟 시간마다 드세요.
어떻게 오셨어요?
배가 아파서 왔는데요.
속도 안 좋으세요?
네, 속도 안 좋고 토할 것 같아요.
언제부터 아프셨어요?
어제 저녁부터 계속 아파요.
그럼 이 약을 한번 드셔 보세요. 식후 세 번, 여덟 시간마다 드시면 돼요.
네, 얼마지요?
5,000원이에요. 이 약을 이틀 정도 드셔 보시고 그래도 안 나으면 병원에 가세요.
네, 감사합니다. 안녕히 계세요.
요즘 이가 계속 아파요.
치과에 가 보는 게 어때요?
이번 주말에 뭐 해요?
유진 씨랑 영화 보러 가기로 했어요.
아키라 씨, 왜 이렇게 기운이 없어요?
모르겠어요. 요즘 계속 피곤하고 입맛도 없어요.
그럼 운동을 좀 해 보는 게 어때요?
민수 씨는 건강을 위해서 특별히 하는 운동이 있어요?
네, 저는 아침마다 수영을 하는데 기분도 좋고 스트레스도 풀려요.
그래요? 어디에서 하는데요?
회사 근처에 있는 수영장에서 해요. 다음 주부터 지호 씨도 같이 하기로 했는데 아키라 씨도 같이 할래요?
네, 저도 시간 내서 한번 가 볼게요.

keep: a whole sentence someone would actually say
5-22 syllables: long enough to need listening, short enough to hold in your head

carries at least one thing you can only write correctly if you know something — the unit's grammar (ㅅ 불규칙, N마다, V-는 게 어때요, V-기로 하다), a gap between sound and spelling (this unit's 발음 point is 종성 규칙 후 연음), or a unit headword
drop: anything under ~5 syllables: nothing to decide when you write it
grammar from another unit — 아키라 씨도 같이 할래요? is Unit 10's -(으)ㄹ래요
filter.splitAtClause: Three printed turns run past 22 syllables. Each is split at its own clause boundary (-고, -는데) rather than trimmed, so no printed line is mutilated to fit.

items.en: Hasn't your cold got better yet?
items.why: ㅅ 불규칙 past. You hear [나아써요], so the ㅅ is gone from the sound — but the stem is 낫다, and 나았- is what carries it. 낫았어요 keeps a ㅅ that drops; 낳았어요 is a different verb (to give birth).

items.en: Yes, I keep coughing.
items.why: 기침이 runs together as [기치미]. Writing what you hear gives 기치미; the boundary only shows if you know the noun is 기침.

items.ko: 이 약을 하루에 몇 번 먹어야 돼요?
items.en: How many times a day do I take this medicine?
items.why: Two liaisons and a tensing: 약을 [야글], 먹어야 [머거야], 몇 번 [면 번]. Nothing in the sound tells you where 약 ends.

items.ko: 하루에 세 번씩, 여덟 시간마다 드세요.
items.en: Three times a day, every eight hours.
items.why: The unit's two counters together — 씩 per dose, 마다 per interval — and 여덟 is said [여덜], the ㅂ never surfacing.

items.en: I came because my stomach hurts.
items.why: 왔는데요 is said [완는데요]: the ㅆ assimilates to the ㄴ that follows. The past tense is only visible in the spelling.

items.en: Is your stomach bad too?
items.why: 좋으세요 is said [조으세요] — the ㅎ drops between vowels and leaves no trace in the sound. 속도 also tenses to [속또].

items.ko: 네, 속도 안 좋고 토할 것 같아요.
items.en: Yes, my stomach is bad and I feel like throwing up.
items.why: Same ㅎ, opposite behaviour: before ㄱ it aspirates instead of dropping — 좋고 [조코]. And 것 같아요 is [걷까타요], where the 것 is a whole word you cannot hear as one.

items.en: Since when has it hurt?
items.why: Honorific past 셨 heard as [셔써]. The ㅅ+ㅆ that spells it is invisible in the sound.

items.en: It's been hurting since yesterday evening.
items.why: 저녁부터 tenses to [저녁뿌터] — you write ㅂ and say ㅃ.

items.ko: 그럼 이 약을 한번 드셔 보세요.
items.en: Then try taking this medicine.
items.why: 약을 [야글] again, and 한번 is one word here — 'give it a try' — not 한 번, 'one time'. The spacing is the meaning.

items.ko: 식후 세 번, 여덟 시간마다 드시면 돼요.
items.en: Three times after meals, every eight hours.
items.why: 식후 is said [시쿠]: ㄱ meets ㅎ and comes out as ㅋ, so the two hanja 食後 disappear into one aspirated sound. N마다 again.

items.en: If it still doesn't get better, go to the hospital.
items.why: The same ㅅ 불규칙 as the first sentence, but here the ㅅ is gone from the spelling too: 낫다 → 나으면. 낫으면 is the mistake this row exists for.
items.splitFrom: 이 약을 이틀 정도 드셔 보시고 그래도 안 나으면 병원에 가세요.

items.en: My tooth keeps hurting these days.
items.why: 이가 is the tooth with its subject particle, not the demonstrative 이. Only the sentence tells you which.

items.en: How about going to the dentist?
items.why: The unit's recommending pattern. 치과 is said [치꽈] with a tensed ㄱ that the spelling does not show.

items.en: What are you doing this weekend?
items.why: 주말에 [주마레]. An easy row on purpose — a dictation set needs somewhere to start.

items.ko: 유진 씨랑 영화 보러 가기로 했어요.
items.en: I've arranged to go see a film with Yujin.
items.why: V-기로 하다 reports a settled arrangement, and it is always past — 했어요, not 해요. 했어요 is said [해써요].

items.en: Why are you so low on energy?
items.why: Three sound changes in a row: 이렇게 [이러케], 기운이 [기우니], 없어요 [업써요]. The ㅄ of 없다 is audible as one ㅃ and spelled with two letters.

items.en: Lately I'm tired all the time and have no appetite.
items.why: 입맛도 is the hardest thing on this track: [임맏또]. The ㅂ becomes ㅁ before ㅁ, the ㅅ closes to ㄷ, and the ㄷ of 도 tenses — three changes, and none of them are written.

items.ko: 그럼 운동을 좀 해 보는 게 어때요?
items.en: Then how about getting some exercise?
items.why: The sentence the chapter is named after, and the pattern it is built on.

items.ko: 민수 씨는 건강을 위해서 특별히 하는 운동이 있어요?
items.en: Minsu, is there any exercise you do particularly for your health?
items.why: The longest row. 특별히 is said [특뼈리] — the ㅎ vanishes and the ㄹ ties on — and 을 위해서 is the unit's purpose phrase, three words that sound like one.

items.en: I swim every morning, and…
items.why: N마다 on a time noun. 수영을 [수영을] keeps its ㅇ, which is what makes it sound like one long word.
items.splitFrom: 저는 아침마다 수영을 하는데 기분도 좋고 스트레스도 풀려요.

items.en: It feels good and it relieves stress.
items.why: 좋고 [조코] once more, and 풀려요 is 풀리다 — something gets relieved by itself. 풀어요 would mean you untie it.
items.splitFrom: 저는 아침마다 수영을 하는데 기분도 좋고 스트레스도 풀려요.

items.en: At the pool near my office.
items.why: 근처에 있는 comes out [근처에 인는]: the ㅆ closes and assimilates. Two words, one sound.

items.ko: 다음 주부터 지호 씨도 같이 하기로 했는데
items.en: Jiho has arranged to join from next week, and…
items.why: 같이 is [가치] — ㅌ before ㅣ comes out as ㅊ, the change that catches everyone. V-기로 하다 again.
items.splitFrom: 다음 주부터 지호 씨도 같이 하기로 했는데 아키라 씨도 같이 할래요?

items.ko: 네, 저도 시간 내서 한번 가 볼게요.
items.en: Sure, I'll make time and give it a go.
items.why: 볼게요 is said [볼께요]. The tensing is real and you must not write it — 볼께요 is the single most common misspelling of this ending.
